people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.
translations.bsb: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance, like the sand of the sea, that he stopped keeping track of it; for it was beyond measure.
translations.kjv: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for it was without number.
translations.asv: And Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left off numbering; for it was without number.
